brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Lieberman declared the Oslo Accords a failure and called for dismantling the Palestinian Authority, Ma'an reported. Lieberman's statement represents a hardline position that rejects the foundational framework for Israeli-Palestinian negotiations established in the 1990s.

The Oslo Accords have formed the basis of Palestinian self-governance structures since their signing. Lieberman's call to dismantle the Authority signals rejection of the existing political framework governing Palestinian territories.
title: Lieberman calls for dismantling Palestinian Authority, rejects Oslo Accords
